home.hero_subtitle: A home for everyone to rest and connect— and find their refreshment. A safe place where hope meets people.
home.about_body: Cup of Hope isn't an ordinary coffee shop. Our story began in 2021, right in the middle of the Covid-19 pandemic — a season when fear, loss, and uncertainty filled the world. While many were forced to close their doors, God speaks to us to open ours with a simple but bold purpose: to bring hope to our city and the people in it.
home.card_body: Hope is something we need to live out every day. These cards of hope are downloaded and written by our team regularly. Every month, we write new words of encouragement on our cards, and we also change the design. The words often show up at just the right moment, and have blessed so many lives.

testimonials.quote: You will make it guys, because God carries you. Don't you worry, He is in control.
testimonials.story: For Joy, it was deeply personal. Just five minutes before stepping into Cup of Hope, she had been telling her friends how anxious she felt about an upcoming trip to another city. She was overwhelmed and uncertain. Then came the card with the exact words she needed. At that moment, she felt strengthened. Reminded that God is always one step ahead, and she isn't alone.
testimonials.name: Joy

about.hero_body: In Cup of Hope we put God as our centre of everything. As we receive His love and grace, we pass on His love by serving people with excellency and give them the same love and grace that we receive. We believe this love and grace will build home and bring hope to the people which ripples and have a lasting impact in this lovely city, Surabaya.
build_body: People are at the heart of what we do. Our heart is to be a safe space for people who feel lost, broken, and not having a place to belong. This place is a home, where we build a family. Here, they encounter the love of God that heals, restores, and transforms - a place to feel safe, to start over, to dream again.
hope_body: In the middle of a world filled with chaos, we have a vision to stand and be a light in the darkness. We know that hope is the answer for that. Hope has the power to reach people's hearts, to restore what's broken, and to transform lives. We're here to share that hope to everyone.

In our home, every customer gets a card with a message of encouragement, we call it "Card of Hope". When people walk into this house, they don't just get good coffee, but something deeper. They experience love, healing, and get a brand new hope.
about.family_intro: From the beginning, we believed that even in the darkest times, light can still break through. And as we journeyed forward, the people who walked through our doors didn't just become our team — they became family.
family_story1: Our senior manager faced a personal crisis that brought him to his lowest point— where he had to run away from home for years. But through God's grace, his father found him and brought him into our community. After experiencing healing and transformation here, he now shines brightly with purpose to lead and serve others. His two sisters also joined our mission as Hope Changers.

Another brother carries a powerful testimony. For seven years, due to some circumstances, he isolated himself in his room. Yet, when he was brought to Cup of Hope, something shifted. Through grace and support, he slowly blossomed—transforming from a withdrawn young man into a confident leader. Today, he passionately brews delicious coffee as our senior barista, training the next generation to walk in excellence.
family_story2: Meet the girl behind our lovely Card of Hope. Once felt lost after being unable to continue her studies during Covid. She came with no experience, no confidence, and no clear direction. Yet in this home, she discovered her gifts. Today, she flourishes in our media department, using her talents to share messages of hope and light. What started as a small coffee shop has grown into a place where people encounter love, healing, and the courage to begin again — a place where hope feels real and alive.
about.impact_body: Here at Cup of Hope, we measure our success not just by the coffee we serve, but by the lives we touch and the moments of change we inspire. Here's a look at the difference we've made together.

connect.title: Lets get connected!
connect.body: We love to connect with you. Either you’re here just to say hi or you have stories and testimonies to share. Youre always welcome to reach us out!

home.hero_subtitle: Rumah bagi siapa saja untuk beristirahat dan terhubung—serta menemukan penyegaran. Tempat yang aman di mana harapan bertemu manusia.
home.about_body: Cup of Hope bukan sekadar kedai kopi. Kisah kami bermula di 2021, di tengah pandemi Covid-19—masa ketika ketakutan, kehilangan, dan ketidakpastian memenuhi dunia. Sementara banyak yang terpaksa menutup pintu, Tuhan menggerakkan kami untuk membuka pintu kami dengan tujuan sederhana namun berani: membawa harapan bagi kota kami dan orang-orang di dalamnya.
home.card_body: Harapan adalah sesuatu yang perlu kita jalani setiap hari. Kartu harapan ini didoakan dan ditulis oleh tim kami secara rutin. Setiap bulan, kami menulis kata-kata penyemangat baru di kartu kami, dan kami juga mengubah desainnya. Kata-kata itu sering hadir di momen yang tepat dan telah memberkati begitu banyak orang.

testimonials.quote: Kalian pasti bisa, karena Tuhan menopang kalian. Jangan khawatir, Dia yang memegang kendali.
testimonials.story: Bagi Joy, ini sangat pribadi. Lima menit sebelum memasuki Cup of Hope, dia bercerita kepada teman-temannya betapa cemasnya ia dengan perjalanan ke kota lain. Ia kewalahan dan tidak pasti. Lalu datang kartu dengan kata-kata yang tepat yang ia butuhkan. Saat itu, ia merasa dikuatkan. Diingatkan bahwa Tuhan selalu selangkah di depan, dan ia tidak sendirian.
testimonials.name: Joy

about.hero_body: Di Cup of Hope kami menempatkan Tuhan di pusat segalanya. Saat kami menerima kasih dan anugerah-Nya, kami meneruskan kasih-Nya dengan melayani sesama secara prima dan memberi mereka kasih dan anugerah yang sama. Kami percaya kasih dan anugerah ini akan membangun rumah dan membawa harapan yang berkelanjutan di kota kami, Surabaya.
build_body: Manusia ada di hati segala yang kami lakukan. Hati kami ingin menjadi ruang aman bagi mereka yang merasa hilang, terluka, dan tidak punya tempat untuk berpijak. Tempat ini adalah rumah, di mana kami membangun keluarga. Di sini, mereka mengalami kasih Tuhan yang menyembuhkan, memulihkan, dan mengubah—tempat untuk merasa aman, memulai lagi, dan bermimpi lagi.
hope_body: Di tengah dunia yang penuh kekacauan, kami punya visi untuk berdiri dan menjadi terang di kegelapan. Kami percaya harapan adalah jawabannya. Harapan punya kuasa menyentuh hati, memulihkan yang rusak, dan mengubah hidup. Kami ada untuk membagikan harapan itu kepada semua orang.

Di rumah kami, setiap tamu menerima kartu berisi pesan penyemangat—kami menyebutnya "Kartu Harapan". Saat orang melangkah ke sini, mereka tidak hanya mendapat kopi yang enak, tapi sesuatu yang lebih dalam: kasih, pemulihan, dan harapan baru.
about.family_intro: Sejak awal, kami percaya bahwa bahkan di saat paling gelap, terang tetap bisa menembus. Dan seiring perjalanan kami, orang-orang yang melintasi pintu kami tidak sekadar menjadi tim—mereka menjadi keluarga.
family_story1: Manajer senior kami pernah mengalami krisis pribadi yang membawanya ke titik terendah—ia harus pergi dari rumah selama bertahun-tahun. Tetapi melalui anugerah Tuhan, ayahnya menemukannya dan membawanya ke komunitas kami. Setelah mengalami pemulihan dan transformasi di sini, ia kini bersinar dengan tujuan untuk memimpin dan melayani orang lain. Dua saudari perempuannya juga bergabung dalam misi kami sebagai Hope Changers.

Saudara lain menyimpan kesaksian yang kuat. Selama tujuh tahun, karena berbagai keadaan, ia mengurung diri di kamarnya. Namun saat dibawa ke Cup of Hope, sesuatu berubah. Melalui anugerah dan dukungan, ia perlahan berkembang—dari pemuda yang tertutup menjadi pemimpin yang percaya diri. Kini ia dengan penuh semangat meracik kopi lezat sebagai barista senior kami, melatih generasi berikutnya untuk melayani dengan prima.
family_story2: Ini dia yang berada di balik Kartu Harapan kami. Pernah merasa hilang karena tidak bisa melanjutkan studi saat Covid. Ia datang tanpa pengalaman, tanpa percaya diri, dan tanpa arah yang jelas. Tapi di rumah ini, ia menemukan talentanya. Kini ia berkembang di departemen media kami, menggunakan bakatnya untuk menyebarkan pesan harapan dan terang. Yang bermula dari kedai kopi kecil telah tumbuh menjadi tempat orang mengalami kasih, pemulihan, dan keberanian untuk memulai lagi—tempat di mana harapan terasa nyata dan hidup.
about.impact_body: Di Cup of Hope, kami mengukur kesuksesan tidak hanya dari kopi yang kami sajikan, tapi dari kehidupan yang kami sentuh dan momen perubahan yang kami bangkitkan. Ini sekilas perbedaan yang telah kita wujudkan bersama.

connect.title: Mari Terhubung!
connect.body: Kami senang sekali bisa terhubung denganmu. Entah kamu datang hanya untuk menyapa, atau ingin berbagi cerita dan kesaksian, kamu selalu diterima dengan tangan terbuka. Jangan ragu untuk menghubungi kami ya!
